_readme: Replaces the report-style lines in lone-actions.js scentLines() (pin 3a9f923): 'The scent of X is on this ground.', 'Prey sign is thin.', 'Hazard sign: tar.' and the rest. Each key matches one push() in scentLines. {name} is a met cat, {pride} is a pride name. Every line states only what the code already knows: homeZones means the cat lives on this ground, the rival flag, the holder, the player's own hunt within 2 days, the preyWord band and the hazard ids. The opener is an optional first beat. Every other line keeps its current position.
opener: You lower your nose to the ground and breathe in slowly, sorting this place out scent by scent.
catKnown: {name}'s scent is everywhere here, rubbed on the stones and soaked into the earth. This is ground {name} walks often.

catStrange.male: A tom you don't know walks this ground often. His scent is on every stone, rank and confident.
catStrange.female: A she-cat you don't know walks this ground often. Her scent clings to every place she's passed, light and wary.

rivalKnown: Deep claw-scores gouge the ground, and they reek of {name}. It's a warning, and it's meant for anyone who comes this way.
rivalStrange: Deep claw-scores gouge the ground, the earth still raw in them. Whoever left them wants every passing cat to know.

prideMarked.highcrag: Highcrag has marked this ground, carefully and at regular intervals, the way an old pride does everything.
prideMarked.bonefield: Bonefield has marked this ground, heavily, sprayed high and often, as if daring anyone to argue.
prideMarked.mistwood: Mistwood has marked this ground, but only faintly, and the marks are few and far between. There are fewer of them to mark it than there once were.
prideMarked.unmet: A pride has marked this ground, one you haven't met yet. The marks are strong and many-voiced, and they tell you this land belongs to somebody.

ownKill: Your own kill-scent still hangs over this ground, faint now beneath everything else.

prey.rich: Under it all, the ground is thick with prey-scent: hoofprints, droppings, warm musk on the wind. Good hunting here.
prey.fair: There's prey-scent here, enough of it to hunt, if you're patient.
prey.thin: Prey-scent is thin and old here. Whatever lived on this ground has moved on or been eaten.

hazard.avalanche: The snow above has a heavy, waiting smell to it, and the slope creaks. One wrong sound and it could all come down.
hazard.bear: Bear. The scent is musky and unmistakable, and it's fresh. Your fur rises all along your spine.
hazard.cold_snap: The air has a hard, metallic bite that stings your nose. A bitter cold is coming.
hazard.flood: The earth smells of churned mud and snowmelt. The water is rising somewhere close.
hazard.lost_trail: The trails here cross and recross until the scents blur together. It would be easy to lose your way.
hazard.rockfall: Fresh stone dust hangs in the air, and loose scree lies scattered below the cliff. The rock here is not to be trusted.
hazard.starvation: There's no food-smell here at all, only bones picked clean and old, cold droppings. This is starving ground.
hazard.tar: The sharp black stink of tar catches in your throat. Somewhere close, the ground is waiting to swallow a careless paw.
hazard.thin_ice: The ice smells wet and rotten underneath. It won't hold much weight for long.
hazard.wolves: Wolf. Many wolves, their scents layered thick over one another. A pack hunts this ground.

nothing: The wind has scoured this place clean. Whatever has passed here, it's left nothing you can read.
